vectors.name: smtp-ruby-reply
vectors.about: A threaded Ruby reply (smtp), no operator edit. meta and source are NOT hashed; the whole item is.

vectors.name: smtp-ruby-reply-edited-subject-body
vectors.about: Same draft after the operator edited subject and body (edited_json): a different hash, so a prior approval is void.

vectors.name: smtp-ruby-reply-edited-recipients
vectors.about: An operator edit that carries recipients inside edited_json: every key of edited_json is hashed, so this differs from the unedited draft.

vectors.name: smtp-ruby-reply-recipient-changed-in-payload
vectors.about: The recipient list changed inside payload_json (recipientEmail and recipientsList): a different hash.

vectors.name: smtp-from-identity-changed
vectors.about: Same row, but the send-time identity (RUBY_IMAP_USER) differs: a different hash. The approver is shown, and the hash binds, the mailbox that will send.

vectors.name: unicode-escapes-and-key-order
vectors.about: String escaping (quote, backslash, newline, tab, U+0001, DEL, U+2028, an astral emoji) and key order by UTF-16 code unit: the key U+1D4B3 (surrogate pair D835 DCB3) sorts BEFORE U+FF5E, the opposite of UTF-8 byte order.

vectors.name: listmonk-default-template
vectors.about: listmonk with LISTMONK_TEMPLATE_ID unset: the send-time identity is the adapter default "1".

vectors.name: buffer-thread
vectors.about: buffer: the channel id is the identity; nested objects and arrays (media.thread) are serialized with the same rules.

vectors.name: unwrapped-payload
vectors.about: payload_json with no `item` wrapper: the whole parsed object is the payload.
